subject: ESTABLISH YOUR PROGRAMS IN KAKUMA REFUGEE CAMP
message:
Dear Sir/Madam

I hope you are doing well.

My name is PRINCE MLENYA, and I am reaching out on behalf of Stand Up Community to express my strong interest in collaborating with you to introduce and establish your initiative in Kakuma Refugee Camp, Kenya.*

I am inspired by this approach, which brings together comedians, academics, and grassroots organizations to use humour-led activities as a tool to spark dialogue and promote a fairer society. I believe this model has strong potential to positively impact refugee and host communities in Kakuma, where there is a need for innovative, community-based psychosocial support and engagement.

Through my work with local communities, including refugees and marginalized groups, I have seen how creative expressions specially humor can help people cope with stress, build resilience, and strengthen social cohesion. Establishing this initiative in Kakuma could provide a safe and inclusive space for individuals to share experiences, heal, and connect.

I would welcome the opportunity to explore a potential partnership with you, including how we might adapt this model to the local context and collaborate on implementation.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
PRINCE MLENYA
Stand Up Community
princemlenja199@gmail.com
